head: Xfinity price increase December 2026: what's known so far
dek: Comcast says some Xfinity prices go up starting in December 2026 but hasn't published the amounts. Its Broadcast TV Fee for local ABC, CBS, FOX and NBC stations is already over 42 dollars a month in some areas.
details: Xfinity points to rising costs, network investment and what TV programmers charge it. Prices on a promotion or minimum-term agreement stay the same until that ends, but taxes, fees and equipment charges can change at any time. Cord Cutters News reports Broadcast TV Fees in the low to mid 40s in several areas and 48.30 dollars in one Connecticut market; with regional sports fees, extra charges can top 50 dollars a month.
where: Xfinity customers in the US, from December 2026; amounts vary by area
means: If you pay for Xfinity TV, your bill may rise in December even if you're on a promotion, because fees aren't covered by the promotional price.
todo: Sign in to your Xfinity account and read the important information section of your bill for your own changes. Cord Cutters News notes the local channels can be watched free with an antenna where the signal reaches.
